topic: Day 134 — reel — Ambition aimed only at status can succeed and still feel empty
text:
Status goals can
be [reached] and
still feel empty.
caption:
They satisfy a social metric, not a psychological need. That's why arriving sometimes produces confusion instead of relief.

Follow for one of these a day.
